Container.Name: ollama-telegram
Container.Overview: Telegram bot that lets you chat with your local LLM via Ollama.

Config.Name: Admin IDs
Config.Description: Comma-separated Telegram user IDs with admin access (can change model and control the bot). Example: 1234567890,0987654321

Config.Name: User IDs
Config.Description: Comma-separated Telegram user IDs allowed to chat with the bot. Example: 1234567890,0987654321

Config.Name: Initial Model
Config.Description: Default Ollama model to use on startup. Example: mistral:latest

Config.Name: Ollama Base URL
Config.Description: Base URL of your Ollama instance (no trailing slash). Use http://ollama if Ollama runs in Docker on the same network, or http://<unraid-ip> if Ollama uses host networking.

Config.Name: Ollama Port
Config.Description: Port your Ollama instance listens on.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone for the container. Example: America/New_York

Config.Name: Group IDs
Config.Description: Comma-separated Telegram group/supergroup chat IDs whose members are allowed to use the bot. Example: -1001234567890,-1009876543210

Config.Name: Allow All Users in Groups
Config.Description: Set to 1 to allow all members of a group chat to use the bot without being listed in USER_IDS.

Config.Name: Response Timeout
Config.Description: Timeout in seconds for generating responses.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: Python logging level (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL).
